summary: Backend regression testing for POST /api/orders ObjectId serialization fix + full order lifecycle (create → approve → complete → logs). Seeded customer/customer_session (verify@test.com/vtok1) and admin_session (torrepablo7040@gmail.com/vadmintok1) directly in MongoDB (test_database). All 9 tests passed (9/9 = 100%).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1100 lines — should be split into routers (orders, admin, customer, settings) for maintainability.

Anti-duplicate transaction_id check happens AFTER building Order object but BEFORE insert — fine, but the 24h window mentioned in the code comment is not actually enforced (query has no time filter). Either enforce the 24h window or update comment.
current_customer/current_admin duplicate 90% of their logic — extract a shared _validate_session helper.
Loyalty point increment uses `earned - doc['redeemed_points']` which could go negative if redeem > earned; consider `$inc` on both fields separately or guard against negative net.
Order side-effects (coupon uses ++, loyalty inc) run AFTER the response is built but are not transactional with the order insert; a crash between insert and side-effects leaves inconsistent state.
test_credentials: Injected in Mongo: customer verify@test.com / Bearer token 'vtok1'; admin torrepablo7040@gmail.com / Bearer token 'vadmintok1'. Sessions valid 7 days.
seed_data_creation: Upserted 1 customer, 1 customer_session, 1 admin_session; teardown removes them and TEST_ orders after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression on POST /api/orders (500 → 200 due to ObjectId leak) is fully fixed via doc.pop('_id', None). Complete flow (create → GET /api/customer/orders → admin approve → admin complete → GET /api/admin/logs) verified. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_orders_regression.py reusable. NOTE: current settings.margin_percent is 2% in DB (not 10% default) — test dynamically reads from settings. Run with `-n 0` to keep class state serial.
rca of the issue: Original 500: FastAPI attempted to JSON-serialize the doc returned from create_order, but Motor's insert_one mutates the passed dict to add a BSON ObjectId under '_id'. ObjectId is not JSON-serializable → 500. Fix applied by main agent (doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one) confirmed working. All downstream GETs already use projection {'_id': 0}.
